title: terrain.wall_rupture
description: M14F L3 catastrophic lateral wall rupture. Emitted when the lateral integrity field drops below the cascade threshold OR when M19 pressure-differential blowout fires. Drives the L3 sidewall crack decal + falling-debris cone + M15 fluid cascade + M19 atmosphere flow.

chunk_id.description: Lateral-wall chunk coordinate as [cx, cy] in chunk-space.

bbox.description: Pixel-space AABB of the rupture breach. M15/M19 read this for fluid + atmosphere flow geometry.

falling_debris_count.description: Pixel count of debris spawned by the rupture. Per spec literal `min(span_px × wall_thickness, 200)`.

unsupported_span_px.description: Unsupported lateral span (in pixels) that drove the rupture.

lateral_yield_strength.description: Per-material lateral yield strength used to determine the rupture threshold.

vibration_modifier.description: Vibration modifier driving the rupture probability.

cascade_primary.description: True for the first rupture in a cascade; false for secondary ruptures triggered via neighbor chunks (VAL-M14F-026).

trigger.description: Cause classifier — 'integrity_decay' (mineshaft / siege wall), 'pressure_blowout' (M19 sudden decompression), 'explosive_damage' (200 dmg threshold).
